title: Suffer
subtitle: 忍受；承受（痛苦、困難或不適）
description: 忍受；承受（痛苦、困難或不適）

words.meaning: 忍受；承受（痛苦、困難或不適）
words.note: 當 suffer 強調長時間承受痛苦、艱難、不適或惡劣處境，而且帶有『撐過去』的意味時，可用 endure。
words.example: The community endured months of water shortages.
words.exampleZh: 這個社區忍受了數月缺水。

exercises.original: The villagers suffered through months of extreme heat without reliable electricity.
exercises.zh: 村民在供電不穩的情況下，忍受了數月酷熱。
exercises.upgrade: endured · 忍受；承受（痛苦、困難或不適）

options.explanation: underwent = 經歷。語義較中性，沒有那麼強的『長期忍受』意味。
endured = 忍受、承受。months of extreme heat + unreliable electricity 明確表示長期艱苦處境。
sustained = 遭受並承受。通常搭配 injury, damage, losses，不搭 months of heat。
was affected by = 受到影響。力度太弱，沒有表達他們實際忍受酷熱。
struggled with = 艱難應對。可用，但更強調處理困難，不如 endured 直接表示長期承受。
was subjected to = 被置於某種待遇／條件下。較被動正式，這裡不如 endure 自然。

exercises.original: The patients suffered weeks of discomfort while waiting for the treatment to take effect.
exercises.zh: 病人在等待治療生效期間，忍受了數週不適。
exercises.upgrade: endured · 忍受；承受（痛苦、困難或不適）

options.explanation: experienced harm = 遭受傷害。discomfort 不一定等同 harm。
went through = 經歷。也可，但更口語、更泛。
was afflicted by = 受……折磨。通常搭疾病或長期問題。
sustained = 遭受。通常搭 injuries/damage/losses。
endured = 忍受。weeks of discomfort 是典型 endure 語境。
faced = 面對。只表示面對問題，不一定承受了數週。

exercises.original: The refugees suffered a long winter in temporary shelters with little heating.
exercises.zh: 難民在幾乎沒有暖氣的臨時住所中熬過漫長冬天。
exercises.upgrade: endured · 忍受；承受（痛苦、困難或不適）

options.explanation: endured = 熬過、忍受。long winter + little heating 明確是持續艱苦。
sustained = 遭受。通常不搭 winter。
was affected by = 受到影響。太弱。
underwent = 經歷。可以，但沒有『忍耐』意味。
faced = 面對。重點在迎戰問題，不是已承受整個冬季。
experienced harm = 遭受傷害。太抽象。

words.meaning: 經歷；遭受（某個過程或變化）
words.note: 當 suffer 指經歷一個通常較正式、可界定的過程、改變、檢查或艱難階段時，可用 undergo。它本身較中性，負面意味主要由後面的名詞提供。
words.example: The region underwent a period of severe economic decline.
words.exampleZh: 該地區經歷了一段嚴重經濟衰退。

exercises.original: The company suffered a major restructuring after several years of losses.
exercises.zh: 公司在連年虧損後經歷了一次大規模重組。
exercises.upgrade: underwent · 經歷；遭受（某個過程或變化）

options.explanation: endured = 忍受。可表示艱難，但 restructuring 是一個明確過程，更自然用 underwent。
experienced harm from = 因……受害。不是重組本身的意思。
was afflicted by = 受……折磨。通常不搭 restructuring。
underwent = 經歷。major restructuring 是非常自然的搭配。
sustained = 承受損失／傷害。不能自然搭 restructuring。
struggled with = 艱難應對。表示處理困難，而不是經歷一個重組過程。

exercises.original: The bridge suffered extensive repairs after inspectors discovered structural weaknesses.
exercises.zh: 檢查員發現結構弱點後，橋樑經歷了大規模維修。
exercises.upgrade: underwent · 經歷；遭受（某個過程或變化）

options.explanation: was affected by = 受到影響。不能精確表示『進行維修』。
endured = 忍受。把無生命橋樑說 endure repairs 不自然。
underwent = 經歷／接受。undergo repairs 是標準搭配。
sustained = 遭受。可說 sustained damage，不說 sustained repairs。
was afflicted by = 受困擾。通常不搭 repairs。
faced = 面對。橋樑本身不是在『面對』維修。

exercises.original: The patient suffered several tests before doctors could confirm the diagnosis.
exercises.zh: 醫生確認診斷前，病人接受了多項檢查。
exercises.upgrade: underwent · 經歷；遭受（某個過程或變化）

options.explanation: experienced hardship = 經歷艱難。tests 不等於 hardship。
endured = 忍受。可表示難受，但醫療語境更標準是 undergo tests。
sustained = 遭受。搭配錯。
was affected by = 受到影響。不能表達接受檢查。
went through = 經歷。口語可用，但正式醫療搭配不如 underwent。
underwent = 接受／經歷。undergo tests 是自然醫療用法。

words.note: 當 suffer 泛指因貧困、失業、戰亂、災害等而經歷生活上的艱難，可用 experience hardship。它比 suffer 更明確指出『困苦』本身。
words.example: Many families experienced hardship during the recession.
words.exampleZh: 很多家庭在經濟衰退期間經歷困苦。

exercises.original: Many families suffered during the recession because jobs disappeared and living costs rose.
exercises.zh: 經濟衰退期間，很多家庭因失業和生活成本上升而經歷困苦。
exercises.upgrade: experienced hardship · 經歷艱難；遭遇困苦

options.explanation: was affected by = 受到影響。太弱，沒有表達生活困苦。
sustained losses = 承受損失。只突出金錢損失，不涵蓋整體生活困境。
went through treatment = 接受治療。無關。
struggled with illness = 與疾病抗爭。無關。
experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。job losses + rising living costs 是典型 hardship。
was subjected to = 被置於某種待遇。語境不合。

exercises.original: Rural communities suffered after the drought destroyed crops and reduced household income.
exercises.zh: 旱災破壞農作物並減少家庭收入後，農村社區經歷了艱難。
exercises.upgrade: experienced hardship · 經歷艱難；遭遇困苦

options.explanation: experienced harm only = 遭受傷害。可以概括，但這裡更具體是生活困苦。
experienced hardship = 經歷艱難。crop loss + reduced income 直接指向 hardship。
underwent = 經歷。後面通常接一個明確過程名詞。
sustained injury = 受傷。無關。
was afflicted by illness = 受疾病困擾。無關。
faced a test = 面對考驗。太泛。

exercises.original: The workers suffered for months after the factory closed and wages stopped.
exercises.zh: 工廠關閉、工資中斷後，工人經歷了數月困苦。
exercises.upgrade: experienced hardship · 經歷艱難；遭遇困苦

options.explanation: experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。factory closure + no wages + months 是最直接線索。
underwent repairs = 接受維修。無關。
sustained damage = 遭受損害。太抽象，而且通常用於物件或具體損失。
was affected slightly = 輕微受影響。力度相反。
was afflicted by = 受……困擾。需要補出 illness/problem，結構不完整。
was subjected to criticism = 遭受批評。無關。

words.note: 當 suffer 的核心是某人、群體或事物受到實際傷害或損害，而不特指某一種傷害時，可用 experience harm。這個說法較正式、分析性。
words.example: Children may experience harm when exposed to unsafe conditions.
words.exampleZh: 兒童暴露於不安全環境時可能受到傷害。

exercises.original: Residents may suffer if polluted water continues to enter the local supply.
exercises.zh: 如果污染水繼續進入本地供水，居民可能會受到傷害。
exercises.upgrade: experience harm · 遭受傷害；受到損害

options.explanation: endure = 忍受。可以說 endure hardship，但這裡重點是實際傷害風險。
undergo = 經歷。通常要接明確過程或治療。
experience harm = 遭受傷害。polluted water + health risk 是典型正式風險表達。
sustain a loss only = 只承受損失。太窄。
face = 面對。只表示風險，不表示實際受到傷害。
be affected mildly = 輕微受影響。和 harm 的力度不符。

exercises.original: Wildlife can suffer when plastic waste enters rivers and coastal habitats.
exercises.zh: 塑膠垃圾進入河流和沿岸棲息地時，野生動物可能受到傷害。
exercises.upgrade: experience harm · 遭受傷害；受到損害

options.explanation: undergo = 經歷。沒有明確過程名詞。
endure = 忍受。可以但較擬人化。
be subjected to = 被置於。需要一個明確外在待遇或條件。
sustain losses = 承受損失。wildlife 本身不自然說 sustain losses。
be affected by only = 只是受到影響。力度不足。
experience harm = 遭受傷害。環境污染對野生動物造成 harm 是自然正式表達。

exercises.original: Consumers could suffer if the product fails to meet basic safety standards.
exercises.zh: 如果產品不符合基本安全標準，消費者可能受到傷害。
exercises.upgrade: experience harm · 遭受傷害；受到損害

options.explanation: undergo hardship = 經歷困難。太泛，且不一定是安全傷害。
endure discomfort = 忍受不適。只是一種可能結果。
be afflicted by = 受……折磨。需要具體問題。
experience harm = 遭受傷害。safety standards 明確是 harm/risk 語境。
face inconvenience only = 只面對不便。力度太弱。
sustain a profit = 獲利。語義相反。

words.note: 當 suffer 不一定表示嚴重痛苦，只是某人、地區、系統或業務受到某個負面因素影響時，可用 be affected by。它比 suffer 中性、力度較弱。
words.example: Local businesses were affected by the road closure.
words.exampleZh: 本地商戶受到封路影響。

exercises.original: Small shops suffered because the road closure reduced foot traffic.
exercises.zh: 小店因封路令客流下降而受到影響。
exercises.upgrade: was afflicted by · 受到……影響

options.explanation: sustained injuries = 受傷。商店不能這樣說。
was afflicted by = 受……困擾。通常更強且偏疾病／問題。
underwent = 經歷。road closure 不是商店本身 undergo 的過程。
endured = 忍受。可用但語氣更強。
was affected by = 受到影響。reduced foot traffic 是典型中性影響語境。
was subjected to = 被置於／遭受。通常更強制、更正式。

exercises.original: Flights suffered because of heavy fog at the airport.
exercises.zh: 航班因機場大霧而受到影響。
exercises.upgrade: were affected by · 受到……影響

options.explanation: were affected by = 受到影響。weather disruption + flights 是最自然搭配。
sustained = 承受。不能單獨這樣用。
underwent = 經歷。航班不自然說 underwent fog。
endured = 忍受。把 flights 擬人化，不自然。
experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。只能形容人或群體生活處境。
were afflicted by = 受困擾。對航班太強且不自然。

exercises.original: Several departments suffered when the computer system went offline.
exercises.zh: 電腦系統離線時，多個部門受到影響。
exercises.upgrade: were affected by · 受到……影響

options.explanation: underwent tests = 接受測試。無關。
sustained injuries = 受傷。無關。
endured pain = 忍受痛苦。太擬人化。
experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。對部門運作太重。
were affected by = 受到影響。system outage 對多個部門造成運作影響，很自然。
were afflicted with = 患有／受……困擾。通常搭 illness/problem。

words.meaning: 遭受；承受（傷害、損失、破壞）
words.note: 當 suffer 後面是 injury, damage, losses, casualties 等具體傷害或損失時，常可用 sustain。這是正式新聞、法律、商業和醫療語境常見搭配。
words.example: The building sustained serious damage in the storm.
words.exampleZh: 大樓在暴風雨中遭受嚴重破壞。

exercises.original: The driver suffered serious injuries in the collision.
exercises.zh: 司機在碰撞中受了重傷。
exercises.upgrade: sustained · 遭受；承受（傷害、損失、破壞）

options.explanation: was affected by = 受到影響。太弱。
endured = 忍受。通常說 endured pain，而不是正式描述 injury occurrence。
underwent = 經歷。不能說 underwent injuries。
was afflicted by = 受……折磨。較常搭 illness。
experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。不是具體受傷。
sustained = 遭受。sustain serious injuries 是非常常見正式搭配。

exercises.original: The factory suffered heavy damage during the flood.
exercises.zh: 工廠在洪水期間遭受嚴重破壞。
exercises.upgrade: sustained · 遭受；承受（傷害、損失、破壞）

options.explanation: underwent = 經歷。可說 underwent repairs，不說 underwent damage。
experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。工廠不適合。
sustained = 遭受。sustain damage 是標準搭配。
was afflicted by = 受困擾。對工廠不自然。
endured = 忍受。可比喻但不如 sustain 正式。
faced = 面對。表示風險，而不是實際已受損。

exercises.original: The business suffered losses after two major clients cancelled their contracts.
exercises.zh: 兩名主要客戶取消合約後，公司蒙受損失。
exercises.upgrade: sustained · 遭受；承受（傷害、損失、破壞）

options.explanation: experienced harm = 遭受傷害。太泛。
endured = 忍受。可以說 endured losses，但商業正式搭配更常用 sustained losses。
was affected by = 受到影響。沒有直接說實際虧損。
sustained = 蒙受。sustain losses 是標準商業搭配。
underwent = 經歷。不能自然說 underwent losses。
was subjected to = 遭受。通常需要外在施加的待遇或條件。

words.note: go through 是很常見的口語片語，當 suffer 指某人經歷一段艱難、痛苦、壓力大的時期時，可用 go through。它比 undergo 更口語。
words.example: She went through a very difficult period after the accident.
words.exampleZh: 事故後她經歷了一段非常艱難的時期。

exercises.original: He suffered a very difficult period after losing his job and moving away from home.
exercises.zh: 失業並搬離家鄉後，他經歷了一段非常艱難的時期。
exercises.upgrade: went through · 經歷；熬過

options.explanation: went through = 經歷。a very difficult period 是最常見的口語搭配。
sustained = 遭受。通常要接 losses/injuries/damage。
was affected by = 受到影響。太弱。
underwent repairs = 接受維修。無關。
was afflicted with = 患有。需要疾病或問題。
was subjected to = 遭受。語氣較正式且通常有外在施加者。

exercises.original: The family suffered several stressful months while waiting for the court decision.
exercises.zh: 一家人在等待法院裁決期間經歷了數月壓力很大的日子。
exercises.upgrade: went through · 經歷；熬過

options.explanation: endured only = 只是忍受。也可，但日常口語更自然說 went through stressful months。
underwent = 經歷。通常接較明確過程名詞。
sustained = 遭受。搭配不合。
was affected by = 受到影響。沒有表達整段經歷。
went through = 經歷。stressful months 是典型 go through 語境。
experienced harm = 遭受傷害。並非一定有 harm。

exercises.original: She suffered a lot during the divorce but gradually rebuilt her life.
exercises.zh: 離婚期間她經歷了很多痛苦，但逐漸重新建立生活。
exercises.upgrade: went through a lot · 經歷；熬過

options.explanation: was affected by mildly = 輕微受到影響。力度太弱。
went through a lot = 經歷很多艱難。during the divorce + rebuilt her life 是自然口語。
sustained losses = 蒙受損失。太具體且不全面。
underwent treatment = 接受治療。無關。
was subjected to = 遭受。結構不完整。
faced only = 只面對。不能完整表達已經歷很多痛苦。

words.note: 當 suffer 指長期受到疾病、疼痛、飢荒、貧困或其他嚴重問題困擾時，可用 be afflicted by / with。語氣正式而且較強。
words.example: The region has long been afflicted by drought.
words.exampleZh: 該地區長期受旱災困擾。

exercises.original: The region has suffered from repeated droughts for decades.
exercises.zh: 這個地區數十年來一直受反覆旱災困擾。
exercises.upgrade: was subjected to · 受……折磨；受……困擾

options.explanation: was affected slightly by = 輕微受影響。和 decades of repeated droughts 不符。
underwent = 經歷。可用但沒有長期困擾意味。
sustained = 遭受。通常接 damage/losses。
was subjected to = 遭受。也可，但 afflicted by 更自然搭長期災害困擾。
was afflicted by = 長期受……困擾。repeated droughts for decades 是典型。
went through once = 經歷一次。與 repeated/decades 相反。

exercises.original: He has suffered from chronic back pain for years.
exercises.zh: 他多年來一直受慢性背痛折磨。
exercises.upgrade: faced · 受……折磨；受……困擾

options.explanation: underwent = 經歷。通常不說 undergo chronic pain。
endured only = 忍受。也可，但 afflicted by 更正式地表達長期病痛困擾。
was afflicted by = 受……折磨。chronic pain for years 是典型。
sustained = 遭受。一般搭 injury，不搭 chronic pain。
was affected mildly by = 輕微受影響。力度不符。
faced = 面對。沒有長期受折磨意味。

exercises.original: The town suffered from serious unemployment after the mine closed.
exercises.zh: 礦場關閉後，小鎮長期受嚴重失業問題困擾。
exercises.upgrade: was afflicted by · 受……折磨；受……困擾

options.explanation: experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。居民可以這樣說，但 town + unemployment 更自然可說 afflicted by。
was affected by = 受到影響。力度較弱。
was afflicted by = 受……困擾。serious unemployment 是持續社會問題，搭配自然。
underwent = 經歷。不能自然說 town underwent unemployment。
sustained = 蒙受。通常接 losses/damage。
went through a test = 經歷考驗。太泛。

words.note: 當 suffer 指一個人正在努力應付疾病、債務、壓力、學習困難或其他持續問題時，可用 struggle with。它強調『問題很難處理』，而不只是被動承受。
words.example: Many students struggle with anxiety during exam season.
words.exampleZh: 很多學生在考試季都苦於焦慮。

exercises.original: She suffers from severe anxiety and finds crowded places difficult to manage.
exercises.zh: 她苦於嚴重焦慮，很難應付擁擠場所。
exercises.upgrade: struggles with · 艱難應對；苦於

options.explanation: sustains = 承受。不能自然搭 anxiety。
undergoes = 經歷。不能自然說 undergo anxiety。
is affected by only = 只是受到影響。太被動、太弱。
endures only = 忍受。可以，但句子還有 finds ... difficult to manage，強調應對困難。
struggles with = 苦於、艱難應對。anxiety + difficulty managing crowded places 是典型。
is subjected to = 遭受。通常有外在施加因素。

exercises.original: The business has suffered with cash-flow problems since several customers began paying late.
exercises.zh: 自從多名客戶延遲付款後，公司一直苦於現金流問題。
exercises.upgrade: struggled with · 艱難應對；苦於

options.explanation: struggled with = 艱難應對。cash-flow problems + ongoing since... 是典型。
sustained = 蒙受。通常接 losses，而不是 problems。
underwent = 經歷。不能自然搭 problems。
was afflicted by only = 受困擾。也接近，但商業語境常自然說 struggle with problems。
endured once = 忍受一次。與持續性不符。
was subjected to = 遭受。通常不是企業處理內部現金流問題的自然說法。

exercises.original: He suffered with reading difficulties throughout primary school.
exercises.zh: 他整個小學階段都苦於閱讀困難。
exercises.upgrade: struggled with · 艱難應對；苦於

options.explanation: underwent = 經歷。不能自然搭 reading difficulties。
struggled with = 苦於、艱難應對。throughout primary school 表示持續努力應付問題。
sustained = 遭受。搭配不合。
was affected lightly by = 輕微受影響。和 throughout 不符。
was subjected to = 遭受。reading difficulties 不是外在施加的待遇。
faced once = 面對一次。和長期困難相反。

words.meaning: 遭受；被置於（不愉快待遇或條件）
words.note: 當 suffer 指被迫承受批評、歧視、虐待、壓力、測試或惡劣條件時，可用 be subjected to。它強調外在因素施加在某人／某物身上，語氣正式。
words.example: Workers were subjected to unsafe conditions.
words.exampleZh: 工人被迫在不安全環境下工作。

exercises.original: The employees suffered repeated verbal abuse from their supervisor.
exercises.zh: 員工反覆遭受主管的言語辱罵。
exercises.upgrade: were subjected to · 遭受；被置於（不愉快待遇或條件）

options.explanation: underwent = 經歷。可用但沒有『被施加』的意味。
experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。太泛。
sustained = 遭受。通常搭 injuries/losses。
was affected by = 受到影響。力度太弱。
went through = 經歷。口語而且不突出施害者。
were subjected to = 遭受。verbal abuse from supervisor 明確是外在施加的不當待遇。

exercises.original: Residents suffered constant noise from construction work throughout the night.
exercises.zh: 居民整晚遭受施工的持續噪音。
exercises.upgrade: were subjected to · 遭受；被置於（不愉快待遇或條件）

options.explanation: were affected mildly by = 輕微受影響。constant all night 明顯不是輕微。
underwent = 經歷。不能自然搭 noise。
sustained = 承受。通常不搭 noise。
were subjected to = 被迫承受。constant construction noise 是典型外在條件。
experienced hardship only = 經歷困苦。太泛。
went through once = 經歷一次。不能表達持續外在噪音。

exercises.original: The material suffered extreme pressure during laboratory testing.
exercises.zh: 這種材料在實驗室測試中承受了極端壓力。
exercises.upgrade: was subjected to · 遭受；被置於（不愉快待遇或條件）

options.explanation: was afflicted by = 受困擾。通常不用於材料測試。
endured = 忍受。對無生命材料較擬人化。
was subjected to = 被施加。laboratory testing + extreme pressure 是非常典型的正式技術用法。
experienced hardship = 經歷困苦。只能自然用於人或群體。
struggled with = 艱難應對。材料不能 struggle。
was affected slightly by = 輕微受影響。和 extreme pressure 不符。

falseSynonyms.zh: 痛苦；疼痛不等於一般的 suffer pain 是名詞，表示痛苦本身；suffer 是動詞，表示經歷或承受痛苦。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You suffer pain; pain is what you feel.

falseSynonyms.zh: 傷心的不等於一般的 suffer sad 是情緒形容詞。人可以 suffer 而不一定感到 sad，例如遭受財務損失或設備損壞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Suffering may involve sadness, but the two are not equivalent.

falseSynonyms.zh: 失去；輸掉不等於一般的 suffer lose 只表示失去某物或輸掉比賽；suffer 可以搭 losses，但本身範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A company may suffer losses, but suffer does not simply mean lose.

falseSynonyms.zh: 失敗不等於一般的 suffer fail 表示沒有成功或沒有達標；suffer 表示承受負面經歷或影響。失敗可以導致 suffering，但不是同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Failure may cause suffering, but fail and suffer are different verbs.

falseSynonyms.zh: 受傷；疼痛；傷害不等於一般的 suffer hurt 和 suffer 有部分重疊，但 hurt 更常指疼痛或造成傷害；suffer 可用於困苦、損失、疾病、負面影響等更廣語境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can suffer financial losses without being physically hurt.

falseSynonyms.zh: 死亡不等於一般的 suffer die 是死亡這個結果；suffer 可指死亡前的痛苦，也可指很多完全不涉及死亡的負面經歷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Someone can suffer without dying.

falseSynonyms.zh: 痛苦；受苦不等於一般的 suffer suffering 是名詞或現在分詞；suffer 是動詞原形。詞性和句法位置不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Suffer is the verb; suffering can be the noun.

falseSynonyms.zh: 容忍；忍受不等於一般的 suffer tolerate 強調接受或忍受某事而不反抗，和 endure 有部分重疊，但不能代替 suffer 的受傷、受損、受影響等多種用法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may tolerate noise, but a building sustains damage rather than tolerating it.
